train: same 48 RealSR T, shared RGB linear least-squares fit to HR minus V1.4; ridge=0.0001
dev: first 15 scene IDs in the previously established RealSR V ordering per camera; disjoint from both earlier v1.5 development panels
criterion: For each of the two V cameras, require mean PSNR >= V1.4 -0.03 dB, mean LPIPS <= V1.4, mean texture amplitude error <= V1.4. Among eligible choose minimum pooled LPIPS; identity is available. Final comparisons with both prior V1.5 and V1.4. Independent new-seed DRealSR V if available, no DRealSR tuning.
